Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 4.4, 11.1-11.2; court D. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7CGKXVT75KY91D3KATA9, bd-01M35A7CQVFV9PYPABKXH3624W, bd-01M1C2TVHC71HJTPRRE09DXVGR.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own integrated source-only and rich text-reading acceptance, not duplicate score/search implementation. Reuse the substantial second-narrative fixture ticket and both generated M1 examples. Verify the fourth mockup plus text-story recall handoff.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Without recall, a scientist reads canonical text, understands supplied major structure, inspects context/participants/relations and reveals selected events after collapse.
2. Add a compatible recall without losing source identity/position; wrong edition refuses; remove recall returns to the same reading investigation.
3. Sparse/partial structure, missing source-text capability and discontiguous support retain honest useful behavior; record actual same-binary browser and exact-text evidence.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep source reading available independently of recall; do not call the miniature proof of substantial-text generality.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Story] Qualify source-only reading and recall attachment on unfamiliar text
